Create a detached Commons data source

Source: R/commons-adapter.R
graft_commons_data_source.Rd

graft_commons_data_source() materializes accepted public tables and definitions at one immutable boundary, then loads exact typed values and a generated data-dict dictionary into commons::data_source(). The returned Commons source owns its DuckDB connection and does not share Graft's backend.

Usage

graft_commons_data_source(source, classes = NULL)

Arguments

source

An initialized GraftStore or immutable GraftView.

classes

Optional public class names to materialize. The default is every public class in the active schema.

Value

A detached commons_data_source object.
